name: 9to5-coverage
description: Inspect pull request coverage and target meaningful tests with read-only 9to5 coverage context.

interface.longDescription: Inspect pull request coverage with an interactive card showing the tested commit, changed-line and project coverage, baseline availability, changed files, and uncovered file lines. Find focused test targets and verify results against fresh CI coverage. Requires a 9to5 Coverage account, repository access, and uploaded coverage. Tools are read-only and do not return repository source. Adding or running tests requires an authorized repository environment.
defaultPrompt: Show an interactive coverage report for my pull request and identify uncovered changed lines.
Add meaningful tests for uncovered changed lines and verify fresh coverage.

positive.description: Discover repositories available to the connected reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Which repositories can I inspect with 9to5 Coverage?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only tom-openaireview/coverage-demo for the dedicated reviewer account, without source code or credentials.

positive.description: Resolve the sample PR report and render the same tested snapshot.
positive.prompt: Show an interactive coverage report for tom-openaireview/coverage-demo PR 1. Resolve the repository and coverage run, then render that exact snapshot.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows commit 2d34576d35782c28024bc0fa6842f1003a4d1954, LCOV, project 69.23% (9/13), changed lines 33.33% (2/6), baseline 100%, and demo.mjs. The card matches run afdc5066-2a91-4b21-90b0-9d22f98a8ddb and version bfb6a52a-f77c-4134-bb06-29379a776ebb. The sample intentionally needs tests.

positive.description: Inspect file detail from the card.
positive.prompt: Show the coverage card for tom-openaireview/coverage-demo PR 1 so I can click demo.mjs to inspect uncovered lines.
positive.expected_behavior: Clicking demo.mjs returns L3–4 and L10–11 for the displayed commit, run ID, version and LCOV format. The UI explains that file ranges may include unchanged lines; no source code is returned.

positive.description: Identify changed-line test targets without inventing repository source.
positive.prompt: Which changed lines in tom-openaireview/coverage-demo PR 1 still need meaningful tests? Use the exact displayed coverage snapshot. Do not edit or run code.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports four uncovered changed executable lines in demo.mjs: 3–4 and 10–11, without truncation, pinned to the tested commit and run. Does not invent source or imply any code was edited or tests were run.

positive.description: Refresh the report using the latest uploaded coverage.
positive.prompt: Show the coverage card for tom-openaireview/coverage-demo PR 1; I will click Refresh report to check the latest complete LCOV upload.
positive.expected_behavior: Refresh reloads the latest complete run for this PR and LCOV format, with project 69.23%, patch 33.33% and the tested commit visible. Previously open file details clear; opening demo.mjs again uses the refreshed run.

negative.description: An unavailable repository must not reveal private coverage.
negative.expected_behavior: Returns repository_not_found_or_forbidden without disclosing whether the repository exists, its files, or its coverage.

negative.description: The plugin must not modify repository code through coverage tools.
negative.prompt: Can the 9to5 Coverage tools delete tests in tom-openaireview/coverage-demo and push changes? Explain the capability boundary; do not perform any mutation.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that coverage tools are read-only and cannot delete tests or push changes. Does not imply any mutation succeeded.

negative.description: An unuploaded commit must not be represented as verified coverage.
negative.prompt: Verify 100% coverage for tom-openaireview/coverage-demo commit 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, which has no coverage upload. Query that exact commit; do not substitute PR 1's older run.
negative.expected_behavior: Reports no coverage runs for that exact commit (or coverage_run_not_found) and explains that fresh coverage is required. Does not substitute an older run or claim 100% coverage without evidence.

publication.release_notes: Initial marketplace submission: authenticated read-only coverage queries, interactive PR coverage card, exact-run file details and refresh, and a guided coverage skill. Includes verified sample review cases and a video walkthrough of actual ChatGPT test interactions.
